url.description: Original input URL or bare domain requested for auditing.

normalizedInputUrl.description: Normalized HTTP/HTTPS URL derived from input.

finalUrl.description: Resolved homepage URL after validated HTTP redirects.

status.description: Audit execution status (audited, blocked_ssrf, blocked_robots, error).

sitePlatform.description: Detected storefront or web platform (shopify, woocommerce, wordpress, webflow, wix, squarespace, healthcare-web, saas-web, custom).

siteVertical.description: Classified site vertical (healthcare_or_wellness, ecommerce_or_dtc, media_or_video, b2b_or_saas, general_business).

detectedCmp.description: Detected Consent Management Platform (onetrust, usercentrics, cookiebot, osano, termly, trustarc, ketch, securiti, didomi, iubenda, complianz, custom-cmp, none).

consentModeV2Detected.description: Whether Google Consent Mode default-denied gating (gtag('consent', 'default', ... 'denied')) was detected.

loadTimeMs.description: Total site audit duration in milliseconds.

pagesFetchedCount.description: Total HTML pages fetched for this site (homepage + discovered internal intake/video/privacy subpages).

pagesFetched.description: URLs of all HTML pages inspected on this site.

errorMessage.description: Diagnostic error or security block reason when status is not audited.

complianceScore.description: Deterministic 0-100 CIPA, VPPA, HIPAA/MHMDA & GPC technical compliance score (100 = no heuristic issues detected).

riskTier.description: Heuristic compliance risk tier: CRITICAL, HIGH, MODERATE, or LOW.

sessionReplayVendors.description: All detected session-replay vendors (fullstory, hotjar, microsoft-clarity, logrocket, mouseflow, lucky-orange, crazy-egg, contentsquare, smartlook, posthog-replay).

ungatedSessionReplayVendors.description: Session-replay vendors loading eagerly without prior-consent script gating.

chatWidgetVendors.description: All detected third-party live-chat & AI chatbot vendors (intercom, drift, zendesk-chat, gorgias-chat, tidio, livechat, hubspot-chat, crisp, ada-chat, qualified).

ungatedChatWidgetVendors.description: Third-party chat vendors booting eagerly without prior-consent script gating.

preChatRecordingDisclosureFound.description: Whether explicit real-time chat recording / third-party chat processing consent or notice was found.

wiretapRiskFound.description: Whether CIPA §§ 631/632 / ECPA session-replay or third-party chat wiretap risk was detected.

wiretapChatAndReplayCheck.description: Detailed CIPA §§ 631/632 session-replay, third-party chat, CMP gating, and recording-disclosure analysis.

embeddedVideoProviders.description: Detected embedded video providers (youtube, youtube-nocookie, vimeo, wistia, jwplayer, mux, vidyard, brightcove, html5-video).

adPixelVendors.description: All detected ad-tech identity/conversion pixels (meta-pixel, tiktok-pixel, google-ads, linkedin-insight, pinterest-tag, snap-pixel, reddit-pixel, x-pixel, criteo).

ungatedAdPixelVendors.description: Ad-tech pixels loading eagerly without prior-consent script gating.

vppaRiskFound.description: Whether embedded video players co-exist with ungated ad-tech identity pixels without standalone VPPA consent.

vppaVideoPixelCheck.description: Detailed VPPA 18 U.S.C. § 2710 embedded video + ad-pixel co-presence analysis.

sensitiveIntakeFormFound.description: Whether a healthcare, wellness, appointment, or patient intake form was detected.

sensitiveFormPixelLeakFound.description: Whether ungated ad pixels or session-replay scripts fire directly on a healthcare/sensitive intake form page.

sensitiveFormPixelCheck.description: Detailed HIPAA 45 CFR § 164.502(e) / WA MHMDA / FTC Health Breach sensitive intake form tracker analysis.

ccpaPrivacyChoicesLinkFound.description: Whether a "Your Privacy Choices" or "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" opt-out link/control was found.

gpcOrOptOutRiskFound.description: Whether active ad-tech trackers lack a CCPA opt-out link or GPC compliance declaration.

gpcAndOptOutCheck.description: Detailed CCPA/CPRA /.well-known/gpc.json and "Your Privacy Choices" opt-out analysis.

privacyPolicyUrl.description: Discovered Privacy Policy / Privacy Notice URL.

intakeOrBookingUrl.description: Discovered Appointment / Booking / Patient Intake subpage URL.

videoPageUrl.description: Discovered Videos / Watch / Webinar / Demo subpage URL.

optOutUrl.description: Discovered Your Privacy Choices / Do Not Sell or Share opt-out URL.

discoveredLinks.description: Structured privacy, booking/intake, video, opt-out, and contact URLs discovered on the site.

findingsCount.description: Total number of compliance findings flagged.

findings.description: Prioritized technical compliance findings with ruleId, regulation, severity, evidence, and recommendation.

coldOutreachHook.description: Neutral, factual 1-2 sentence B2B outreach observation tailored for Privacy/CMP, Healthcare Marketing, and E-Commerce agencies.

remediationPackGenerated.description: Whether a CIPA/VPPA/GPC HTML/JS consent-gate + pre-chat disclosure remediation pack was generated.

remediationPack.description: Copy-pasteable Prior-Consent Script Gate Wrapper, Pre-Chat CIPA Disclosure Widget, /.well-known/gpc.json, and CCPA "Your Privacy Choices" HTML/JS snippets.

recommendedNextActors.description: Recommended follow-up Apify Actors (WCAG/ADA Visual Auditor, EU Withdrawal/Omnibus Auditor, and US Click-to-Cancel Auditor).
